<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule. The only way to get structural information is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum, which will show signals for aromatic carbons (typically in the 110‑160 ppm range). By counting those signals we can determine the aromatic carbon count.</thought>
